Lemma
[Vertical action on tensor components] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0444 ↗ def:chow-ii-frame-tensor-components ↗ def:chow-ii-vertical-frame-fields 1. appf:F.8\group Frame Bundle Calculus

For a $(p,q)$-tensor, \[ \Lambda ^c_d U^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p} =\sum _{\ell =1}^p\delta ^c_{b_\ell } U^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_{\ell -1}d b_{\ell +1}\cdots b_p} -\sum _{k=1}^q\delta ^{a_k}_d U^{a_1\cdots a_{k-1}c a_{k+1}\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p}. \]
